name: aes_schedule_scan
description: Find AES-128 and AES-256 expanded key schedules in a file or memory image, at every byte alignment, in standard byte order or with each 32-bit word reversed. Each whole, checked schedule's key goes to a private file in out_dir, never to the answer; the answer gives offset, key size, byte order and the key's sha256. A hit is a lead, not a finding. Not AES-192, not decayed or fragmented keys, not the decryption layout (aes_inverse_scan). Windows over a large image through start, length and budget_seconds.

path.description: The file or memory image to scan (read only)

out_dir.description: Where the key files and the whole result go, inside the run directory and not under inputs/ (default work/<agent>/aes_schedule_scan)

start.description: First byte to test (default 0). A schedule is reported by where it starts, so successive windows never lose or double one

length.description: How many bytes to test from start (default: to the end of the file)

budget_seconds.description: Stop at a chunk boundary after this long and say complete=false with next_start; call again with start=next_start (default 240)
